title: Nested Multilevel Monte Carlo with Preintegration for Efficient Risk Estimation
summary: Nested Monte Carlo is widely used for risk estimation, but its efficiency is limited by the discontinuity of the indicator function and high computational cost. This paper proposes a nested Multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) method combined with preintegration for efficient risk estimation. We first use preintegration to integrate out one outer random variable, which effectively handles the discontinuity of the indicator function, then we construct the MLMC estimator with preintegration to reduce the computational cost.
